Subject: Unexpected duplicate connector charge on May invoice

Hi Sofia,

We reviewed our May invoice (Invoice_20270501.pdf attached) and found a duplicate connector charge of USD 3,200 that appears to be a system duplication on your end. The charge shows up twice under connector 's3-ingest-prod' for the period 2027-04-25 — 2027-05-24.

Can Redwood issue a partial chargeback or credit for the duplicate line? We prefer a credit applied to our next invoice rather than a wire refund, but can accept a refund if needed.

I've attached a page from our bank statement showing the single payment (bank_statement_may.pdf) and our remittance note (remittance_ID_7782.txt). Please confirm what additional evidence you need and the expected timeline — our APAC accounting team needs the correction before month-end close for tax purposes.

Thanks,
Anil Rao
Head of Finance
ClearMap AI

Hi Anil — thanks for flagging this. Looping in Ben (billing ops) and Marissa (finance) to validate the invoice lines and confirm remediation.

High-level plan: 1) Ben will reconcile the meter logs for the connector and confirm whether the duplicate was a billing generation issue; 2) If we confirm duplication, Redwood can issue a goodwill credit of USD 3,200 or apply the credit to your next statement — please confirm preference (you mentioned credit to next invoice). 3) If ClearMap needs a refund instead, we can process a wire after completing reconciliation and KYC for the transaction. 4) For India/APAC withholding (TDS) evidence: if ClearMap will withhold tax on refunds, please provide the TDS certificate so we can include it with our finance records; otherwise, credits applied to future invoices are easier from a tax accounting perspective.

Ben, Marissa — can you confirm the reconciliation ETA and whether we need anything else from ClearMap (metering export, transaction ID)? I will provisionally block the USD 3,200 as a potential credit until we validate.

Sofia

There's an obvious duplicate entry for the connector 's3-ingest-prod' with identical usage id and a duplicated invoice line item id (invline-7782 and invline-7782-dup). Likely a pipeline retry in the billing job created a duplicate line during rollover.

Requesting the following from the customer to close quickly:
- Confirmation of the single payment transaction id (Anil provided remittance_ID_7782.txt, good)
- A copy of any internal GL or AP note showing the single charge (their bank statement is fine)

Proposed remediation options:
A) Issue a goodwill credit of USD 3,200 applied to the next invoice (fastest; no refund wire required).
B) Issue a refund wire for USD 3,200 (requires finance RMA, 3 business days + bank processing; if refund, we should collect their TDS certificate if any withholding applied).

I can prepare the credit memo today if they confirm option A. Marissa, please advise if we should also open a small JIRA to track the billing job fix and document for audit.

- Ben
